# CLAUDE.md improver (Anthropic)

Audits your repo's CLAUDE.md files, scores them and makes targeted improvements.

- Source: https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/main/plugins/claude-md-management/skills/claude-md-improver/SKILL.md
- Author: Anthropic
- License: Apache-2.0
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/claude-md-improver-anthropic-a2fe53a6

Claude finds every CLAUDE.md file in the repository, grades each against quality templates, writes a short report of issues (outdated commands, missing context, bloat) and then makes focused edits. It also suggests tips for keeping project memory useful.

**Try asking:**
- "Audit and improve our CLAUDE.md"
- "Our CLAUDE.md is out of date, fix it"
- "Check all CLAUDE.md files in this monorepo"

**Source:** [anthropics/claude-plugins-official](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-plugins-official/tree/HEAD/plugins/claude-md-management/skills/claude-md-improver) · Apache-2.0 · by Anthropic
